about: Every Mech Kit part: identity + stats. The game reads this same file. Units: weight t (tons), ap = armour points, res = % damage resisted per type, energy = load on the generator, heat/s, speed km/h, jump m, carry t (weight the legs hold), turn deg/s, range m, rate shots/s, reload s. elementTypes = weapon-only damage types (round 7): cryo chills and freezes, void ignores resistances and front armour; armour carries no resistance to them. Round 7 effect fields: ricochet, chainJumps + chainChance (%), seek (deg/s), echo (%), wellRadius (m) + wellTime + wellPull (m/s) + wellDps (%/s), cluster, napalm (s), leech (%), overkill (%).

parts.name: Hauler Treads

parts.name: Pogo Head
parts.blurb: A bucket with a traffic-light eye.

parts.name: Pogo Core
parts.blurb: A barrel with a seat: very light.

parts.name: Pogo Arms
parts.blurb: Scaffold-pole arms: light and quick.

parts.name: Pogo Booster

parts.name: Pogo Bird Legs
parts.blurb: Spring-loaded bird legs: big hops on the cheap.

parts.name: Sunline Sweep Lance
parts.blurb: Hold the trigger: a steady beam that cuts through a whole line of enemies. Drinks energy.

parts.name: Facet Prism Laser
parts.blurb: A bright line that splits into a fan of three where it strikes.

parts.name: Zenith Orbital Lance
parts.blurb: Mark a spot; a beam from orbit lands on it a moment later.

parts.name: Crescent Wave Scythe
parts.blurb: A wide energy swing that throws a cutting wave; every hit repairs you a little.

parts.name: Rift Needler
parts.blurb: Void needles curve into enemies, ignore armour and resistances, and tug what they hit.

parts.name: Hailstorm Cluster Mortar
parts.blurb: A shell that bursts and throws six bomblets around the blast.

parts.name: Deadweight Gravity Launcher
parts.blurb: Fires a heavy void slug that opens a gravity well: enemies are dragged into a pile and ground down.

parts.name: Coldsnap Cryo Projector
parts.blurb: Sprays freezing coolant in a cone: enemies slow down, and a steady stream freezes them solid.

parts.name: Thrum Arc Coil
parts.blurb: Pulses lightning into the nearest five enemies around your frame. No aiming needed.

parts.name: Lantern Seeker Orbs
parts.blurb: Lets loose three slow glowing orbs that drift to enemies and zap whatever they pass.

parts.name: Squall Storm Caller
parts.blurb: Calls a storm over the aimed spot: lightning strikes rain on it for four seconds.

parts.name: Rustbloom Nanite Sprayer
parts.blurb: Lobs canisters of nanites: a cloud that eats at anything inside and leaves it taking more damage.

parts.name: Firepot Lobber
parts.blurb: Lobs pots of fuel that burst into flame and leave the ground burning for four seconds.

parts.name: Boomerang Saw Disc
parts.blurb: Throws a saw disc that cuts everything on the way out and on the way back. Kills burst.

parts.name: Pinball Repeater
parts.blurb: Hard slugs that bounce off one enemy into the next, twice.

parts.name: Sparkplug Carbine
parts.blurb: Jury-rigged coils on the barrel: a third of its hits spark lightning to two nearby enemies.
